create_grasp_dataset: create a GraspDataset instance with a DictConfig and dataset name for tactile vision-based grasp data
get_dataset_sample: get a sample from GraspDataset by index returning tactile images and grasp label
get_dataset_length: get the number of samples in the GraspDataset using len() on the dataset instance
get_tactile_images_single: get a single resized tactile image from a GelSight sensor using the single_image output format
get_tactile_images_video: get a 4-frame video clip of tactile images stacked and permuted for the video output format
